title: Mine output and mineral-concentration depletion

provenance.note: Concentration 0-200; home world never below 30%; 12,500/concentration approximation.

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 969481 (0x000ecb09), HLP file offset 248062 (0x0003c8fe), topic 113 'Mining Colonized Worlds'
provenance.note: Mining formula (potential productivity) x (concentration) = actual productivity.

setup.baseline: An owned planet with known mineral concentration and a controlled number of mines.

procedure: Record concentration and surface minerals at year start.
Add a known number of mines and record next-year output for each mineral.
Vary concentration and mine count independently.
Measure concentration depletion over multiple years.
Test home-world floor of 30% and the concentration=1 floor.

documented: Actual productivity = potential productivity x mineral concentration (documented-only).
Mine years to reduce concentration by 1 are approximately 12,500 / concentration (documented-only).
Minerals never run out completely; concentration falls to 1 and home-world concentration never drops below 30% (documented-only).

unresolved: Exact rounding of each mineral output is unknown.
The potential-productivity base per mine is race-dependent and not fully recovered.
